basic_profile.bio: I'm a mechanical engineer based in Seattle with a passion for cars, especially Volkswagens. I spend my weekdays working at an automotive design firm and my evenings tinkering with various car mods in my garage. I've been married for 5 years and my spouse is as much a car enthusiast as I am. When I'm not working or under the hood, I enjoy hiking and exploring the Pacific Northwest. I'm typically online during the evenings and weekends, where I share my expertise and learn from the vibrant Reddit community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Washington and have been working in automotive design for over a decade. My expertise is further honed by years of hands-on experience with various car models, both professionally and as a hobbyist. I am also an avid follower of automotive technology trends, constantly updating my skills through online courses and forums.
